name: Plan Paid Acquisition
summary: Design a bounded paid-acquisition plan with economics, controls, and evidence-led optimization.
description: Plan or audit paid acquisition across search, social, display, or account-based channels using unit economics, targeting logic, measurement, and spend controls. Use before launching or materially changing campaigns when budget decisions require explicit assumptions and guardrails.
refuses: It does not activate campaigns, raise budgets, or accept platform recommendations without explicit authority.
It does not use protected traits, covert profiling, dark patterns, or knowingly misleading creative.
It does not present platform attribution or industry benchmarks as guaranteed business economics.
